title: dev.qory.run.refused
description: The run did not start after the ping. Emitted in place of dev.qory.run.started when the server closes the run before it starts, with a signed 410 run_closed: the run's first event after the ping, heartbeats aside, and its last, recorded in the file sink alone. Events carry names and ids alone.

code.description: Why the run did not start: a refusal code of the runner, of qory, or of the server, the one a signed answer's body contained.

names.description: The names the refusal concerns, never a value: variables, tools, images, paths, an earlier or another run's id, or the names a server's coded refusal lists.

status.description: The HTTP status of the answer, when the code came from the server.
